unreviewedScope: Every existing private property of the fast arena and lexical-region owner wrappers is classified here. Four observations and one initialization-authority getter are not the full other-model/demo/API/lifecycle/performance/platform/shipping inventory. Friend-only proof is not package-user authority.

schemas.scope: One default or instantiated lexical unmanaged bump owner, not a logical lease table. Its numeric observations grant no payload or owner identity authority.
schemas.consistency: Construction-thread lexical use at mutation boundaries. The private lifecycle getter reads the bound kernel or Uninitialized for the absent default; it does not perform public GetKernel or payload validation.
schemas.resetPolicy: Default remains absent. A real owner transitions Active to Disposed exactly once; failed initialization rolls back its cursor without changing lifetime. There are no region reset, scoped recycle, generations or per-range records.

members.name: CurrentLifecycle
members.definition: Actual bound kernel state, or true Uninitialized for default(NativeRegion). Observing that default state cannot authorize Id, Lease or Dispose; observing a closed kernel cannot restore old Local access.

members.name: CurrentAllocationRecordCountForTest
members.definition: Invariant zero because a lexical region owns bump backing and has no per-range allocation-record table. Fully initialized or empty Local ranges can exist while this value is zero. Never relabel it as logical lease count, initialized bytes or entered callbacks.
members.overflow: Invariant absence; no incrementing counter or hidden bank.

schemas.scope: One thread-confined ordinary/scoped bump owner, including prepared lanes. KernelForInitialization is an internal capability, not an observation or public snapshot field.
schemas.consistency: Construction-thread capture at actual initialization, entered access and maintenance boundaries. Numeric getters themselves read existing state; they do not validate or authorize a lease. The authority getter returns the actual managed arena owner, including after terminal cleanup.
schemas.resetPolicy: Actual lifecycle remains Active through reset and scoped recycle while epochs invalidate earlier derived handles. Dispose closes backing authority. These operations do not create a per-range table. Numeric observations never retain a native extent independently.

members.name: CurrentLifecycle
members.definition: Actual owning arena lifecycle during initialization, entered callbacks, failure rollback, scope recycle, reset and terminal cleanup; active payload or cursor demand is separate from owner lifecycle.
members.overflow: Finite lifetime state; epoch overflow is separately guarded before reuse, not reported through this enum.

members.name: CurrentAllocationRecordCountForTest
members.definition: Invariant zero in this fast ordinary/scoped bump model. Live initialized scratch ranges, entered borrows and recycled backing require no individual record table; generation/scoped identities and actual bytes still exist and are guarded. Zero does not imply an empty arena.
members.overflow: Invariant absent table, not a disabled changing counter.

members.name: KernelForInitialization
members.definition: The actual internal arena-owner reference used to coordinate initialized/composite ranges. It carries operation authority and keeps that managed owner alive. It must not be serialized as numeric telemetry or exposed through public observation snapshots. This exact named/type exclusion prevents suffix-based inventory omission.
members.overflow: Not a counter; lifecycle/initialization guards remain on kernel operations.
members.allocation: Getter creates no wrapper; retaining the reference retains the actual owner and its defined cleanup obligations.
